issues: Prototype pollution (credential theft, request hijacking, header injection)
Cross-client data leak via shared instance
DNS rebinding not protected by default
XSS-based command execution when connecting to untrusted MCP server
ReDoS via repeated wildcards and nested extglobs

mitigation: Pin patched versions in package.json. For production use, isolate in disposable containers only. All fixes are available via npm audit fix.
risk_acceptance: Acceptable for disposable benchmark containers in controlled environments only. Not suitable for hostile-code execution.
